wire-callable-contracts.text: As an existing caller, I need the same functions at the Singular.Registry.Types import path even when their definitions move.

public-callables.text: ToData, FromData and UnsafeFromData are mapped per type in data-model.md. Each instance stays beside its type in the owning module. Shared conversion helpers are internal and have no new public API. No constructor, record selector or visible import path may be dropped from the Types facade.
